sentences.en: We sat around the campfire, roasting marshmallows and singing songs.
sentences.zh: 我们围坐在营火旁烤棉花糖并唱歌。

sentences.en: We all had a good time singing around the campfire.
sentences.zh: 我们在营火旁唱歌玩得很开心。

sentences.en: He was singing with the children sitting around the campfire.
sentences.zh: 他和围着营火坐的孩子们一起唱歌。
